**A local-first AI workspace for your desktop.** Chat with models on your own computer, let an agent work on your files and projects
# Flint
Installers for Windows, macOS and Linux are attached to each release
it runs local models on any GPU through Vulkan, or on the CPU.
Network access happens only for features you explicitly use: Hugging Face **Discover**, a cloud provider
or connect any OpenAI- or Anthropic-compatible provider with your own key.
**Chat** for questions, writing and documents.
**Cowork** for tasks that touch files.
several models from different providers discuss a topic in one room
browse and download GGUF models directly from Hugging Face in **Discover**
A command line** for headless agent runs
Flint is an independent fork of the open-source [Jan](https://github.com/janhq/jan) app, with its own design and features.
brew tap Jozkah/flint https://github.com/Jozkah/flint
brew install flint
npm install -g @jozkah/flint
npm install -g @jozkah/flint
Network access happens only for features you explicitly use: Hugging Face **Discover**, a cloud provider, a remote MCP server, or web search.
Chat with models on your own computer
let an agent work on your files and projects with your approval
browse and download GGUF models directly from Hugging Face in **Discover**
Chat with models on your own computer
An agent reads, writes and runs commands in a sandbox or a managed copy of your project, asks before doing anything you have not allowed
several models from different providers discuss a topic in one room, with a moderator, budgets, `@mentions`
parallel sub-agents, six built-in roles (explorer, planner, implementer, reviewer, tester, security)
a diff before every write, per-hunk apply, managed Git worktrees, checkpoints and rewind
token and prompt-cache counts per message and session, spend budgets, and a dashboard
browse and download GGUF models directly from Hugging Face in **Discover**
use MLX repositories on Apple silicon
connect any OpenAI- or Anthropic-compatible provider with your own key
bubblewrap on Linux, Seatbelt on macOS, AppContainer on Windows
A command line** for headless agent runs, a JSON-lines API and background jobs
MCP server cards with connection state, call rate, tools and an auto-approve switch
run several web searches and fetches in one call
a live tool timeline, replay, audit export
each with its worktree bar and a Create pull request action
You can switch each GPU between CUDA and Vulkan in **System Monitor**
import a GGUF you already have with **Import GGUF**
you can **copy** your Jan data into Flint, **reuse** it in place, **move** it
can be grouped into projects, and can run side by side in a split view
